titulo.en: I would like you to come

intro.en: Use the imperfect subjunctive after a wish or request in the conditional.

quisiera que.en: I would like someone to; I wish someone would

texto.en: With verbs of desire or request, use **que + subjunctive** when the subordinate clause has a different subject: **Quiero que vengas**; **Me gustaría que vinieras**. When both clauses have the same subject, use the infinitive: **Me gustaría viajar**. A change of subject by itself does not choose the subjunctive; the meaning and the expression that introduces the clause matter. Compare **Creo que viene** with **No creo que venga**. Form the imperfect subjunctive from the third-person plural of the preterite: **hablaron → hablara**, **comieron → comiera**, **vivieron → viviera**. The **-ra** forms are common; **-se** forms also exist (**viniese**). The past-looking form does not necessarily describe a past event: after **gustaría**, it can express a present or future wish.

frases.es: Me gustaría que vinieras a comer el domingo.
frases.en: I would like you to come for lunch on Sunday.

frases.es: Me encantaría, pero trabajo por la mañana.
frases.en: I'd love to, but I work in the morning.

frases.es: Quisiera que conocieras a mi hermana. Llega el sábado.
frases.en: I would like you to meet my sister. She arrives on Saturday.

frases.es: Si pudiera cambiar el turno, iría sin problema.
frases.en: If I could change my shift, I would go without a problem.

frases.es: Marcos trabaja en un restaurante y casi siempre recibe sus horarios con pocos días de antelación.
frases.en: Marcos works in a restaurant and almost always gets his schedule only a few days in advance.

frases.es: Le gustaría que su encargada los publicara una semana antes.
frases.en: He would like his manager to post them a week earlier.

frases.es: Su compañera Inés preferiría que el equipo tuviera dos días seguidos libres una vez al mes.
frases.en: His colleague Inés would prefer the team to have two days off in a row once a month.

frases.es: No piden vacaciones más largas: quieren organizarse con tiempo.
frases.en: They are not asking for longer holidays: they want to plan ahead.

frases.es: Si hablaran con la encargada, quizá encontrarían una solución.
frases.en: If they spoke to their manager, they might find a solution.

frases.es: El viernes van a pedir una reunión breve.
frases.en: On Friday they are going to ask for a short meeting.

pregunta.en: Complete: I would like you to come.

vinieras.en: A different subject after me gustaría que takes the subjunctive.

venir.en: Use an infinitive when both clauses have the same subject.

vendrías.en: The conditional does not follow que here.

pregunta.en: Complete: I would like to travel.

viajar.en: The same person has the wish and would travel.

que viajara.en: This would need a different subject, such as que ella viajara.

viajaría.en: The infinitive follows me gustaría when the subject is the same.

pregunta.en: Which form completes the request: quisiera que ustedes ___ más temprano?

llegaran.en: The imperfect subjunctive agrees with ustedes.

llegarían.en: The conditional is not used after que in this request.

lleguen.en: This is present subjunctive; the main verb is quisiera.

pregunta.en: Why do Marcos and Inés want a change?

To plan their lives further ahead.en: They want more notice of their schedules.

To take longer holidays.en: The text says they are not asking for longer holidays.

To leave the restaurant.en: They plan to request a meeting.

bloques.correcta: To plan their lives further ahead

bloques.frase: Preferiría que me avisaras con tiempo

traduccion.en: I would prefer you to let me know in advance.
